title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Board selected chrome now consistently uses --color-primary (GPU Vello theme JSON, headless fallbacks, 2D overlay styles). Highlight / selection-exit chrome uses --color-secondary so preselect preview stays primary while deselected anchors stay secondary-tinted. Rust NODE_FILL_SELECTED codegen uses primary token at 0.35 alpha.
